items: One gate re-shot: 3 new clips; ONEGATEe picked (the field leaves as one row, the stall stays put, nothing jumps).
New outro, a photo finish: the field freezes level, flash, a judges' print scans across, then into the logo.
Now 35.8 s (the outro is 2 s longer than the old card).
Trim toward ~17 s: which pauses or lines go?
A stamp on the print (e.g. "DEAD HEAT": everyone finishes together)? Your words if so.
Music: a Suno round on your credits?

replies.at728: Fixed: ONEGATEa left a ghost row at the gate while the field ran (the "teleport"). Re-shot 3 takes with the stall kept standing; ONEGATEe has the whole field leave level and nothing jumps. The other two (c, d) are on the clips page. Picture only, no new words.
replies.at788: Done: a photo finish. The field freezes level on the line, a camera flash and shutter click, a black-and-white judges' print scans across left to right with a timing ruler and a finish line on the hooves, header "PHOTOGRAPH" (the call a UK course makes), then it dissolves into the logo. Sound synthesised, no outside clips. Want a stamp on it like "DEAD HEAT"? Your words.
